Cadence is **Quarterly** per `docs/health/README.md` / `audit-catalog.md` (requested cycle token `2026-07` retained). New Finding: `SEO-001`. ---

## Executive summary

First SEO cycle for EventPixels. Methods: read-only inspection of `docs/plans/indexability-policy.md`, `src/lib/seo/indexability.ts`, sitemap/robots builders, representative marketing `generateMetadata` / JSON-LD routes, and Next redirects; read-only SQL for topic emptiness counts against live catalog.

Public indexability is largely implemented: company/edition gates, collection filter noindex, admin/login noindex, `/companies` → `/sponsors` permanent redirects, self-canonicals via `createPageMetadata`, Event/Organization/Breadcrumb JSON-LD with safe serialization, and sitemap membership aligned to those gates for sponsors/editions/series/research. Net change: **1 new** Finding (`SEO-001`). **0 resolved**. Primary residual: empty topic hubs remain indexable and sitemap-included contrary to policy §3.4.

## Findings

### SEO-001 — Empty topic hubs remain indexable and sitemap-included

- **Why it matters:** Indexability policy §3.4 says empty or unpublished topic shells should follow soft-404 behavior (`noindex` + sitemap exclude). `getTopicIndexability()` always returns `INDEXABLE`, and `fetchPublicTopicSitemapEntries` includes every non-empty `keyword.slug` with no emptiness gate. Live catalog has **4 / 16** topics with zero `event_series_keyword` links (`cloud`, `data-analytics`, `defi`, `healthcare`). Those URLs still resolve as thin hubs (`getTopicHubData` returns empty series/editions) while competing in the organic index and sitemap allowlist.
- **Severity:** Medium · **Effort:** Small
- **Evidence:**
  - `docs/plans/indexability-policy.md` §3.4 — empty shells → `noindex` + sitemap exclude
  - `src/lib/seo/indexability.ts` — `getTopicIndexability()` unconditionally `INDEXABLE`
  - `src/lib/seo/sitemapEntries.ts` — `fetchPublicTopicSitemapEntries` selects all keyword slugs; only `getTopicIndexability().includeInSitemap` (always true)
  - `src/features/events/server/topicHubPublic.ts` — `getTopicHubData` serves empty series/editions when no series links
  - `src/app/(marketing)/topics/[slug]/page.tsx` — metadata uses `getTopicIndexability()` without emptiness check
  - Read-only SQL (2026-07-31): 16 topics with slugs; 4 with `series_links = 0` (slugs above)
- **Status:** Open
- **Recommended action:** Gate topic indexability (and sitemap inclusion) on a concrete public-value signal (e.g. ≥1 linked series, or ≥1 public edition under linked series). Align `getTopicIndexability`, topic `generateMetadata`, and `fetchPublicTopicSitemapEntries` to the same helper so membership ⇔ indexable.
- **Scope:** `/topics/{slug}` templates and topic sitemap entries.
- **Validation / acceptance criteria:** Empty topic shells emit `noindex` (or soft-404) and do not appear in sitemap; topics with real linked content remain indexable and listed; helper is the single source of truth for metadata + sitemap.
- **Uncertainty / false-positive risk:** Low on mechanism/policy drift. “Empty” defined here as zero series keyword links; a topic with links but zero public editions would need a follow-up check (not observed as the primary set this cycle). Policy doc header still says “not yet fully implemented” — code is the authority for crawler behavior.
- **Related:** None existing under SEO/PROD for this root; distinct from `PROD-002` (exhibitors stub).

## Observations (not tracked)

### Strengths

- Shared IR1 helpers drive company/edition/series/collection/research decisions; sitemap uses the same gates for sponsors, editions, series, and research quality gate.
- Collection filter/search URLs on `/events` and `/sponsors` correctly noindex via `getCollectionIndexability`.
- `createPageMetadata` sets stable self-canonicals and avoids `*.vercel.app` in public metadata (`getSiteUrl`).
- Admin layout and login emit `noindex`; soft-404 helper uses `createNotFoundPageMetadata`.
- Permanent redirects consolidate `/companies` → `/sponsors`.
- JSON-LD builders omit incomplete graphs; `serializeJsonLd` escapes script-breaking sequences (tests present).
- Sponsor metadata fails open on unknown stats count (does not emit noindex from a failed count query) — intentional IR1 trade-off noted in code.

### Report-only notes

- **`/exhibitors`:** Marketing metadata claims search/analyze capability; body is roadmap stub. Default indexable; excluded from static sitemap. Cite **`PROD-002`** — do not open SEO clone. Prefer product remediation (remove/noindex/redirect) over a parallel SEO ID.
- **`robots.ts`:** Allows `/` for all agents; does not `disallow` `/admin`. Admin is covered by layout `noindex`. Policy prefers disallow as optional; under-track without crawl-waste evidence.
- **Checklist items considered and rejected (no EventPixels harm evidence):** hreflang, image sitemap, FAQ schema, Open Graph image per entity, keyword copy rewrites.
- **Policy doc drift:** Header still “not yet fully implemented”; research § IR1 deferral is stale relative to shipped topic×region hubs + gated sitemap. DOC may refresh later — not an SEO Finding.
- **Cadence:** Framework schedules SEO **Quarterly**; this baseline uses the requested cycle token `2026-07`.

### Limitations

- No Google Search Console export this cycle.
- Did not fetch live HTML for every entity; relied on route/metadata source and spot policy alignment.
- Topic emptiness sampled via series-link counts only.
- Did not measure sitemap build latency or URL volume ceilings (PERF/SCALE).
